verdict.rationale: Published deadlines are a fair question for an immigration agency. IRCC publishes at least one exact founder-relevant deadline: Start-up Visa applicants with a 2025 commitment certificate must apply by June 30, 2026. The evidence shows no schedule of consequences, penalties or interest for missing it. Missing for 10: a published penalty and interest schedule with exact figures, deadlines across other filing types, and any stated consequences for missed deadlines.
